title: vosa: Variance-Optimized Saliences Analysis for Multiblock Data (R package)
description: R package implementing VOSA (variance-optimized saliences analysis) and the family of criteria g_alpha = (1 - alpha) level^2 + alpha contrast, which contains CPCA, INDORT (orthogonal INDSCAL, simultaneous ComDim) and VOSA, computed with the Shifted Polar Ascent algorithm; STATIS for comparison; outputs in the canonical factorization X_k = U D_k V_k' + E_k; diagnostics; and a script reproducing the results of the accompanying article.
